summary: Implemented a bounded deterministic resolver from one exact selected native Pod/controller container declaration to one qualified immutable per-container Pod-status image candidate.
Desired tag/digest and actual status image/imageID are separate; source UID/resourceVersion, Pod UID, container type/name/instance/restart/state and native owner links bind the observation.
No image bytes, registry authorization, live deployment effectiveness, secret detector result or clean-content claim is produced.

primary_contracts.verified: ContainerStatus has name/image/imageID/containerID and distinct regular/init/ephemeral status arrays. Image fields permit runtime resolution. These are reported status, not proof of a registry response or runtime filesystem.
Native Pod GET includes PodSpec declarations and PodStatus. A namespace/name identifies an API resource; UID and resourceVersion bind the supplied object observation.

Tags can move; digests identify content. A tag plus digest pulls by digest. Default image registry can be customized by runtime; imagePullSecrets are separate Secret references, not review credentials.
Docker shorthand defaults to docker.io and library/ for official images; index.docker.io is a documented legacy alias. No arbitrary private alias or mirror equivalence is implied.
Registry pulls use repository-scoped manifest references and blob digests. Returned manifest/blob bytes require digest verification; a mutable tag alone is insufficient byte identity.

Descriptor digest and size bind bytes; SHA256 uses 64 lowercase hex characters. Different index/config/layer/platform manifest objects have separate content identities; association does not verify descriptor relationships.

Native ownerReferences include owner name and UID; namespaced owners and dependents share a namespace. The resolver requires exactly one matching controlling owner and does not infer ownership from labels.
Deployment desired containers are in spec.template.spec; Deployment status is not per-container Pod imageID evidence.
CronJob desired containers are in spec.jobTemplate.spec.template.spec. Its selected Job and Pod require their own exact native links.
Namespace Roles can restrict GET to exact resourceNames. Pod object reads do not authorize registry data-plane access.
ConfigMap data and binaryData are separate API content fields, independent of metadata-only projections. Decoded UTF8 bytes and selected key coverage must be explicit.
BatchGetImage accepts imageIds.imageDigest and returns native registry/repository/image identity and manifest bytes.
Layer download locations are bound to registryId, repositoryName and layerDigest; existing guarded transport must verify actual downloaded bytes.
Artifact Registry uses independently authorized Google identity and registry read access; the existing reader consumes a transient token for fixed selected registry origins.
Registry management access and repository content pull authorization are separate. Existing ACR reader checks native registry identity and registry permission mode before repository pull.

resolver_contract.entrypoint: resolve_image_source(selection, declaration, *, cluster_id, pod_selection=None, pod=None, owner_chain=())

container_types.init: spec.initContainers -> status.initContainerStatuses, including restartable init sidecars

controller_links: Deployment -> exact ReplicaSet -> exact selected Pod
CronJob -> exact Job -> exact selected Pod
resolver_contract.controller_limit: Current selected image declaration must agree across all supplied objects. Old rollouts and admission-mutated different image declarations stay unresolved; one associated Pod is not controller-wide convergence or replica coverage.

status_semantics.associated: qualified immutable image candidate reported by one selected native Pod container status
status_semantics.declaration_only: desired immutable controller/template image without selected Pod evidence; no scanner target
status_semantics.unknown: missing or unsupported or unverified relation; no scanner target
status_semantics.mismatch: selected native identity/owner/repository/container or declaration disagrees; no scanner target
status_semantics.invalid: malformed or exceeded bounded input subset; no scanner target

unknown_boundaries: Bare runtime/config hashes do not prove manifest identity.
Container state waiting or missing/invalid instance counters/timestamps cannot bind current instance.
Desired/status differing digests need verified index-to-platform descriptor relation; do not infer contradiction or equality.
Only Docker documented shorthand/index alias normalized; custom runtime default and private mirrors/aliases not guessed.
Unsupported SHA512/other algorithms, IPv6 registries and foreign native API versions remain unsupported.
No lastState, readiness, Pod phase, pull policy, replica count, matching label or current registry tag can substitute for selected status imageID.
resolver_contract.input_trust_boundary: Already-decoded native JSON from caller; no transport completeness, authentication, raw byte/depth bound or lost duplicate JSON-key validation can be supplied by this pure function.
resolver_contract.output_privacy_boundary: Association contains only selected image/object/instance identity fields, not env/annotations/Secret references or content; these identity strings still need union redaction before any future snapshot/export.

validation.native_shapes: API-versioned complete Pod/controller dictionaries including metadata UID/resourceVersion, spec, state/status arrays and ownerReferences; deterministic synthetic fixtures, not live observations.
validation.guards: Autouse socket/create_connection/getaddrinfo/subprocess denial; explicit file-open denial for resolver; AST import allowlist dataclasses/datetime/re and no registration/scanner symbols; input equality and ignored-field traversal tripwires.
